::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 6th 1861  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1861/4
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd),

I send the papers about [Sandwell](organizations/other_12.qmd), and a [back number](other_books/otherbook_301.qmd) of the [M P](organizations/other_52.qmd), which please return. I have scarcely heard anything about the institution since I received this account from [Miss Goodrich](people/person_567.qmd) so my knowledge of it is two years old[^1]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Miss Ann Smith/ Rectory/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester (date torn) and London SE 7 March 1861.
[^2]: This letter identifies the A.M.G. who published 'Sandwell'  in *MP* (March 1859) 330-334, as Miss A. M. Goodrich.
